subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that collocates with ‘wish’ to fill in the blank.

The genie asked Aladdin to ________ a wish.
solution:
The correct answer is '**make**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase "**make a wish**" is a common collocation meaning to express a desire for something.
 
• In the context of the sentence, "**make**" is the appropriate verb that collocates with "wish".
 
• The other options: "**ask**," "**tell**," and "**take**" do not fit the context as accurately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *The genie asked Aladdin to make__ a wish.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Ask a wish (पूछना)**: Not a correct collocation in English.
 
• **Tell a wish (कहना)**: Not a correct collocation in English.
 
• **Take a wish (लेना)**: Not a correct collocation in English.
